title: Feelings ko naam dena: kya research kehti hai?
topic: Affect labelling: controlled-task emotion-regulation evidence and limits

events.detail: Manifest और स्थानीय कार्य-निर्देशिका बनाई गई; कोई मीडिया अभी उत्पन्न नहीं।
planned → researched. Affect-labelling source record includes controlled-task evidence, neuroimaging association, context moderation, and explicit prohibited overclaims.
researched → verified. Central claims are bounded to study conditions; no diagnostic, therapeutic, causal-brain-switch, or universal calming claim is permitted.
verified → scripted. Hindi voiceover draft uses only source-recorded controlled-task findings and explicit evidence limits.
scripted → voiced. Hindi voiceover is 60.64 seconds; transcription readback informed six timed caption segments.

voiced → rendered. A 1080x1920 H.264/AAC MP4 was assembled from a topic-specific generated master visual, Hindi narration and burned-in captions using the documented 15fps deterministic fallback renderer.
rendered → qc_passed. Technical QC passed: non-empty MP4, 1080x1920 portrait geometry, audio stream, 60.667-second duration and SHA-256 recorded.

qc_passed → uploaded. Final MP4 plus eight supporting source, script, caption, narration, QC, metadata, manifest and visual-provenance artifacts were listed in the canonical Drive folder; final MP4 has a non-empty size and Drive MD5 checksum.

uploaded → complete. Reel 0019 is source-backed, Hindi-voiced, captioned, technically QC-passed, and Drive-package readback verified. Visual provenance is disclosed as a generated master visual with deterministic caption-led assembly.
